newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea says Pyongyang defector safe and secure.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea says Pyongyang defector safe and secure.

text.p: North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop has left China and is safe and secure under South Korean control in a third country, a Seoul official said on Tuesday after reports that Hwang was in the Philippines.

"With the cooperation of a third country we have him staying in a secure and safe place," foreign ministry spokesman Lee Kyu-hyung told reporters, without naming the country. "He's under our control."
"There has been no response from North Korea," Lee said.
"Hwang Jang-yop himself wanted to defect, and the arrangements were made after negotiations with China so I hope no new tensions will develop between South and North Korea."

A foreign ministry statement said the negotiations were based on the principle "that the case be handled in accordance with international norms and practices and in a direction contributing to the maintenance of peace and stability on the Korean peninusla".

Military officers in the Philippines said Hwang flew in to Clark airbase north of Manila on a chartered Air China commercial plane from the southeastern Chinese city of Xiamen. He was then whisked by helicopter to Baguio, about 200 km (125 miles) north of the capital.
